cap.name: Middle pool · curved north end of west planter
cap.trust: Short rounded termination adjoining the existing planter north edge. Curvature and rendered wall are photo-supported; radius about 0.6 m and the exact 0.5 m north extension are estimated against the aerial path band. Original west planter footprint retained.

wall.name: Middle pool · bounded garden wall with brown door
wall.trust: Only the short white wall face containing the closed brown timber door west of the open entrance is represented. Door and wall arrangement supported by both photos; 4.15 m length, 2 m height and exact position estimated from registry frontage and aerial lane bend. No enclosing boundary inferred beyond this fragment.

pergola.name: Middle pool · open north-west pergola entrance
pergola.trust: Open pale shallow curved pergola header with slender dark posts at the north-west lane bend. Shape supported by ground photos; 2.23 m span, 0.7 m depth and height estimated. No closed gate leaf or unobserved continuation added.

steps.name: Middle pool · north planter side steps
steps.trust: Three white-nosed steps climb through the existing continuous west-side terrain rise (survey middle-pool-nw-rise: 0.3-0.55 m). Foot and upper lane are 0 and 0.5 m; tread heights derive from siteY at those endpoints, never a second added plateau. Riser positions and 0.82 m width estimated from the photos within the approximate aerial path alignment; flight extended to the existing upper lane rather than inventing a new level.
